translations.web: But the testimony which I receive is not from man. However, I say these things that you may be saved.
translations.bsb: Even though I do not accept human testimony, I say these things so that you may be saved.
translations.kjv: But I receive not testimony from man: but these things I say, that ye might be saved.
translations.asv: But the witness which I receive is not from man: howbeit I say these things, that ye may be saved.
